Modelos de negócio para restaurantes de pequeno porte: franquias vs. negócios independentes
summary: A decisão de abrir um restaurante é um dos passos mais ousados e, ao mesmo tempo, emocionantes para qualquer empreendedor. No entanto, antes de mergulhar no
body_text: A decisão de abrir um restaurante é um dos passos mais ousados e, ao mesmo tempo, emocionantes para qualquer empreendedor. No entanto, antes de mergulhar no mercado gastronômico, surge uma pergunta essencial: escolher uma franquia ou iniciar um negócio independente? Essa escolha pode definir o sucesso do empreendimento, impactando desde a estratégia inicial até a gestão contínua. Neste artigo, vamos explorar os principais aspectos de cada modelo de negócio, analisando vantagens, desafios e apresentando exemplos de sucesso, para ajudar você a tomar a decisão mais estratégica. O cenário atual para restaurantes de pequeno porte O setor de food service está em constante evolução, especialmente em restaurantes de pequeno porte. Com a crescente demanda por diversidade culinária e inovação, empreendedores têm a oportunidade de atender às preferências locais e personalizadas dos consumidores. No entanto, a competição é acirrada, e a escolha do modelo de negócio adequado é essencial para garantir a sustentabilidade e o crescimento a longo prazo. Diante desse cenário, surgem duas opções distintas: abrir uma franquia de restaurante, onde o empreendedor adere a um modelo de sucesso já estabelecido, ou optar por um negócio independente, criando um conceito próprio. Cada um desses caminhos tem suas particularidades, com benefícios e desafios únicos. Franquias: estrutura e segurança Ao optar por uma franquia, o empreendedor investe em um negócio já testado e aprovado no mercado. Franquias de restaurantes oferecem uma série de vantagens que podem ser atrativas, especialmente para quem busca segurança e suporte. Vantagens das franquias: Marca estabelecida : Um dos principais atrativos de abrir uma franquia é a força de uma marca já conhecida no mercado. O reconhecimento do público reduz a necessidade de construir uma base de clientes do zero, algo que costuma ser desafiador para negócios independentes. Um exemplo disso é a franquia McDonald’s, que possui um público fiel em qualquer localidade onde se estabelece. Suporte operacional e treinamento : Franqueadores geralmente oferecem suporte contínuo, desde o treinamento inicial até orientações sobre operações diárias, marketing e gestão financeira. Para um empreendedor que não tem muita experiência no setor, essa ajuda pode ser crucial para garantir a operação eficiente do restaurante. Modelos de negócio testados : Franquias oferecem um modelo de negócio já validado no mercado, com processos padronizados. O franqueado recebe um “manual de operações”, que inclui desde o cardápio até a logística de compras e a forma de atendimento ao cliente. Isso reduz a curva de aprendizado e aumenta as chances de sucesso, já que erros comuns de startups são evitados. Poder de Compra : Franquias normalmente têm acesso a fornecedores estabelecidos, muitas vezes com descontos e condições exclusivas por conta do volume de compras. Isso permite que o franqueado opere com margens de lucro melhores do que um restaurante independente, que muitas vezes precisa negociar sozinho com fornecedores. Desafios das franquias: Apesar das vantagens, abrir uma franquia também traz desafios. O principal deles é a falta de flexibilidade . O franqueado está restrito às regras da marca, o que significa pouca ou nenhuma autonomia para modificar o cardápio, o layout do restaurante ou as estratégias de marketing. Essa limitação pode ser frustrante para empreendedores com um espírito mais criativo. Outro desafio significativo é o custo inicial . Franquias exigem uma taxa de franquia (franchise fee), além de royalties mensais sobre as vendas. Dependendo da marca, esse investimento pode ser elevado, o que afeta o fluxo de caixa inicial. Além disso, o franqueado deve seguir os padrões da marca, o que pode gerar custos adicionais com reformas, equipamentos e marketing. Exemplo de sucesso em franquias: Um exemplo de sucesso no Brasil é a rede de franquias Spoleto , que cresceu rapidamente ao oferecer ao franqueado um modelo de negócio que combina flexibilidade de cardápio com uma operação estruturada. O suporte dado aos franqueados na escolha de pontos comerciais, gestão de equipe e inovação no cardápio fez com que a marca se tornasse uma das principais opções de franquias no setor de alimentação no país. Negócios independentes: liberdade e inovação Por outro lado, o modelo de negócio independente atrai empreendedores que desejam ter total liberdade para criar e gerir o restaurante. Esse modelo proporciona um caminho para criar algo único, com identidade própria, mas também traz desafios significativos. Vantagens de negócios independentes: Autonomia total : A maior vantagem de abrir um restaurante independente é a liberdade para criar e inovar. O empreendedor pode definir o conceito, o cardápio, a decoração e as estratégias de marketing, adequando o negócio às preferências locais e tendências de mercado. Isso permite uma personalização maior do que o formato de franquia. Menores custos iniciais : Diferente das franquias, que exigem um investimento inicial elevado em taxas e royalties, os custos de iniciar um negócio independente podem ser mais baixos. O empreendedor tem controle sobre onde e como investir, o que pode permitir uma gestão mais eficiente dos recursos. Construção de marca própria : Restaurantes independentes têm a oportunidade de construir uma marca autêntica, que pode se destacar no mercado por sua originalidade. Isso pode criar uma conexão mais forte com os clientes locais, que muitas vezes valorizam negócios que refletem a cultura e as necessidades da comunidade. Desafios dos negócios independentes: O principal desafio de um negócio independente é a falta de suporte estrutural . Diferente de uma franquia, o empreendedor precisa construir seu modelo de negócio do zero, o que envolve a criação de processos operacionais, a escolha de fornecedores, a definição de preços e a estratégia de marketing. Isso pode demandar mais tempo e conhecimento do setor. Outro obstáculo é a dificuldade em atrair clientes inicialmente . Ao contrário das franquias, que contam com o reconhecimento de uma marca consolidada, restaurantes independentes precisam investir mais em marketing para construir uma base de clientes fiel. Além disso, a gestão de riscos é maior em negócios independentes, já que não há garantia de que o modelo de negócio será bem-sucedido. Muitos restaurantes independentes fecham nos primeiros anos de operação devido à falta de planejamento e à dificuldade em equilibrar custos e receitas. Exemplo de sucesso em negócios independentes: Um exemplo notável de sucesso no Brasil é o restaurante Maní , em São Paulo. Fundado pelos chefs Helena Rizzo e Daniel Redondo, o Maní combina inovação e ingredientes brasileiros em pratos criativos que ganharam reconhecimento mundial. Com liberdade para experimentar e construir uma marca única, o restaurante se tornou um destino culinário aclamado, mostrando o potencial de negócios independentes no setor gastronômico. Conclusão: qual o melhor modelo para você? Escolher entre uma franquia ou um negócio independente depende do perfil do empreendedor e dos objetivos a longo prazo. Franquias oferecem segurança, suporte e reconhecimento imediato, mas exigem altos custos iniciais e restringem a autonomia. Por outro lado, negócios independentes proporcionam liberdade e inovação, mas demandam mais esforço em planejamento e construção de marca. Antes de tomar a decisão, é importante avaliar suas habilidades como empreendedor, o capital disponível e sua tolerância ao risco. Se você prefere seguir um caminho mais seguro e contar com suporte contínuo, uma franquia pode ser a melhor opção. Entretanto, se busca liberdade criativa e está disposto a enfrentar maiores desafios para construir algo do zero, um negócio independente pode ser mais adequado. Ambos os modelos têm histórias de sucesso, e o mais importante é escolher o caminho que melhor se alinha aos seus objetivos e visão de negócio.

title: Meeting the Challenges of the Tissue and Paper Market at the Crossroad of Asia and Europe
summary: With a strong presence in the paper and tissue industry, Kadant provides innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, productivity, and sustainability.
body_text: Kadant is a global leader in the supply of high-value, critical components and engineered systems used in process industries worldwide. With a strong presence in the paper and tissue industry, Kadant provides innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, productivity, and sustainability. In Türkiye, the crossroad between Asia and Europe, Kadant is represented by the country manager, Mr. Sami Algan, a seasoned expert and known authority for all Kadant Flow Control solutions , bringing extensive expertise to the market. Could you give an overview of the Turkish tissue and paper market, what are the main challenges and opportunities you face? One of the biggest challenges in the near future is overcapacity with production exceeding domestic demand. As a result, companies are compelled to explore new export opportunities even more than before and be flexible in production planning. This creates a challenge to suppliers as different markets have varying demands; such as quality, cost, paper characteristics, and order size. As Kadant is a partner to manufacturers, we have to be aware of their challenges and support them with the right products and solutions. Additionally , fluctuating raw material and energy costs pose significant challenges. One of the important markets, for Turkish manufacturers, is Europe and “ the green deal ” brings extra responsibility and challenges. However, Türkiye's tissue and paper mills are equipped with new and advanced machinery, providing an excellent opportunity to implement the latest innovative technological solutions from Kadant. What are Kadant's main goals in the coming years? Our primary goal is to ensure that machines in Türkiye run efficiently and have high runnability, even in challenging environments. We believe that maintaining a close partnership between the supplier and manufacturer is crucial. We continue to improve our processes for “just in time” deliveries to ensure continuous production for manufacturers, while reducing stock cost. We offer top-notch expertise and local support , ensuring quick service thanks to our local presence in the region. For the moment, our team in Türkiye consists of five specialists, each with different skills and expertise, allowing us to provide tailored solutions and the best possible support to our customers. We plan to increase sales and service capacity in our team and extend our reach further in the region. What are the main innovations and benefits Kadant is bringing to the market today? Kadant’s key advantage lies in our extensive line of solutions , our expertise and history spans over 100 years. This allows us to understand our customers' needs deeply and offer customized solutions rather than standard products. In terms of sustainability and energy efficiency, our product line includes steam and condensate systems , water recovery systems , doctoring , and cleaning solutions with advanced technology. All are designed to reduce energy consumption and improve machine efficiency and performance to support customers to meet their goals. The real strength of our solutions lies in the extensive network of experts that make up Kadant. We have hundreds of experts worldwide, each with specific skills and knowledge, ready to provide the highest level of support. This network of colleagues, who represent excellence in the paper industry and often have extensive background in paper manufacturing plants, is our greatest asset in meeting the needs of paper companies. How does Kadant support the market in providing technical assistance and training? We recognize the importance of having well-trained operators and engineers, especially in a fast-growing market like Türkiye. That’s why we are developing a training program aimed at machine operators . This program will provide a general understanding of the papermaking and tissue-making processes, deep learning of critical components such as Kadant’s product portfolio, ensuring operators can run machines efficiently. We believe this initiative is part of our responsibility to support mills as they improve the skill level of operators. The operators can then enhance machine efficiency and product quality. Thanks to our in-depth knowledge of all stages of the papermaking process, we are able to support operators , who often have a knowledge limited to their area of specialization, by offering them a “wider perspective.” This allows them to understand how all stages are important and to realize that choices and actions taken at one level can affect the entire process, determining the output and quality of the final product. We also use these sessions to better understand our customers’ challenges and further develop our solutions.

title: Steak Surgery for Low-Fat Weeknight Dinner
summary: Steak is a great way to meet your protein goals, just make sure to make it right.
body_text: Why steak works when you’re counting your macros Steak can be a great way to get plenty of protein, but it can be easy to get too much fat. In order to hit your goals with steak, we have a few tricks we can share. First you have to choose the right steak. It needs to have enough internal marbling to be delicious but still on the lean side. You have to trim the excess fat - “perform surgery”. Finally, you need to cook in a very hot pan with minimal oil and choose sides that err towards an acidic as opposed to a fatty base (think wilted greens over creamed spinach). Here’s how we do it: Choosing your steak If you’ve ever tried to log a steak in a popular calorie or macro tracking app, you’ve probably been greeted with 42 versions of the same thing. The USDA–the source of this data for common meats–uses detailed names like “Beef, Loin, Top Loin Steak, Boneless, Lip Off, Separable Lean Only, Trimmed to 0” Fat, Choice, Raw.” That name is so long, in some apps you can’t even see it all, and some apps will just show you someone else’s (likely incorrect) guesses at macros with a simple, user friendly name. So how do you decode the jargon and get an accurate log? Let’s break down the 3 major categories of fat the USDA uses to classify meats. Trim Fat The first is the external “trim” fat. This fat is literally a ring around the edge of the steak, or a “fat cap” as you might see on some NY Strips. Common USDA choices are “trimmed to 0" and “trimmed to ¼”. This is the easiest fat to remove and we recommend you always do, either before cooking or on your plate. On the other hand, the intramuscular marbling fat is impossible to remove. Intramuscular Marbling Fat This is determined by the USDA grade: Prime has the most fat, Select has the least, and the very common Choice is in the middle. The real decision you have to make is if you’re going to remove the large internal fat blobs. Separable Fat The USDA calls these internal fat blobs “Separable”, so you’ll either end up with “Separable Lean Only” or “Separable Lean and Fat.” This fat is a bit harder to remove because you’re doing surgery to cut holes out of the middle of your steak, but with a sharp paring knife and some practice, you can do it quickly. Trimming your steak Does it matter? An 8oz NY Strip, trimmed to ¼”, Separable Lean and Fat, Prime, is 635 calories with 50 grams of fat. But an 8oz NY Strip, trimmed to 0”, Lean Only, Select, is only 305 calories with 11 grams of fat. That’s a whole dessert of extra calories! Here’s what our NY Strip looked like before and after trimming the fat: We got these steaks at the local grocery store, New York Strip Choice. We also really like Denver Steak, which is a tender cut from the shoulder, but gives you a similar result to NY Strip, often with less fat to trim. You can see after we’ve trimmed the external fat to 0” and removed the internal separable fat with a pairing knife. We got these delivered with Walmart+ InHome but when we get to pick them out myself, we choose steaks where we’ll have to do less surgery on the internal fat. Here you see that we’re left with holes in the steak, and even some completely detached pieces. That’s OK! We bunch the loose pieces up close to the main steak when cooking, but if they are too unwieldy for you, keep them in place with a couple toothpicks. Never skip a generous sprinkling of coarse kosher flake salt and pepper. You can also use a steak spice blend that’s mostly salt, pepper and roasted garlic. Logging and cooking your steak When you log your steak in BODYSIM, you can use our search categories to drill down to the exact cut you are having, and weigh and log the raw steak before cooking. We just sear the steak for 90 seconds on each side. You start by preheating the cast iron pan for at least 10 whole minutes, with the cast iron press in the pan, then once it’s HOT (smoking - seriously, don’t hesitate to get it really really hot), we add 1 generous glug of grapeseed oil and immediately throw the steaks on with the pan, do one quick flip, then apply the press, repeating on the other side for 90 seconds each. Your hot pan and finished steaks should look like this: While our steaks are resting (at least 5 minutes, preferably a bit longer), we make our pan sauce. We blot the extra oil out of the pan and off the steaks first (who wants to log that?), careful not to disturb the brown bits, then pour any excess juices from the steaks on the cutting board back into the pan. The goal is to maximize flavor and minimize fat! Making a pan sauce and side salad Here are my secrets to the perfect pan sauce: Savory beef broth concentrate (Better than Bouillon is also good, but the squeezy bottle is convenient), a vinegar, something spicy (if you don’t have tabasco, just chili flakes are great), a wine (we like dry vermouth because it’s shelf stable), and just 1-2 tablespoons of butter. If you’re really cutting fat, it’ll work without the butter, but it’s a great emulsifier, as you can see in the picture. You just turn the stove off, throw a splash of everything in the pan, add the butter, turn the stove back on high, and let it reduce until it’s darkened in color but not evaporated yet. If you over do and break the sauce, add a quarter cup of water and reduce it again! That hot cast iron pan is going to continue to reduce the sauce so turn the stove off a bit before the sauce is perfect. Here are the ingredients and how your pan sauce should look: Again, unique to BODYSIM, you can save this pan sauce as a sub recipe and easily add it to your future steak (or steak salad!) dinners. Drizzle that sauce over your sliced steak and add a simple green salad. Unique in BODYSIM, you can save sub recipes and use them as components in your logging. My go-to homemade vinaigrette for 2 people is simply 1T Dijon mustard, salt and pepper, 1T vinegar (we mix it up between beer vinegar, champagne, sherry and apple cider) and then a slowly whisked in 1-2T olive oil. A bit of herbes de provence or dried harissa are good too. We had extra calories this night so we also added 1T pepitas and 1T half-sugar craisins to jive up the salad. If you love a creamy side with your steak, try mashed cauliflower, sweet potato, or squash to get the same effect as mashed potatoes with less carbs. Here’s the finished plate: Another good tip for logging your bread is to weigh your typical slice (this is 2 oz), and stick to the same size slice every time! Here’s our logged steaks: Steak is actually a great order when you’re out to dinner too because the restaurant often provides the raw weight of your steak. You can log your cut as “all grades”, and if you don’t eat the fat, you can log it as if it were trimmed. The best side is always a salad, but if you can’t resist steak frites, a serving of fries is 3 oz., which is about 12 to 15 individual fries, or 140 calories. Split them with the table! title: What is PCOS and what are its symptoms?
summary: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is still not fully understood, but we do know that birth control can help alleviate symptoms of the condition.
body_text: Author Zakiya Whatley, PhD Author Nathaniel Scharping Reviewer Lauren A Koenig, PhD Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a relatively common, though still not fully understood, chronic hormonal condition. PCOS can cause a range of symptoms, including menstrual cycle disruptions and metabolic issues, though how it looks can vary a lot from person to person. PCOS often creates fluid-filled sacs, or cysts, in your . These cysts overproduce certain sex hormones called s, which can lead to symptoms like acne and unwanted hair growth.1 But not everyone with PCOS develops these cysts, and some people will have cysts without having PCOS. The condition is complex, and the causes aren’t even completely known right now.1 But PCOS affects between 5-10% of people with who are of childbearing age, and it’s a common cause of .1 PCOS also usually occurs alongside increased resistance and weight gain. The connection means PCOS is often tied to additional health risks, like diabetes and cardiovascular problems.1 PCOS also often goes undiagnosed,1 so it’s worth discussing with your doctor if you have one or more PCOS symptoms that won’t go away. Though PCOS symptoms can be frustrating and worrying, there are treatments available. is often prescribed to help with PCOS.2 The hormones in can decrease levels and help with many of the symptoms of PCOS. Read more: What’s the best ? What are the signs of PCOS? Common PCOS symptoms include:3 Excessive body hair, particularly on your face, chest, back, or stomach Irregular periods, very heavy, or very light periods Belly weight gain Bloating and cramps Difficulty getting pregnant or lack of ovulation Dark patches of skin or other skin abnormalities Pattern balding or scalp hair loss Doctors now recognize that there is probably more than one kind of PCOS .4 PCOS is often diagnosed through higher-than-normal levels, ovarian cysts, and altered menstruation. But not everyone with PCOS has all of these symptoms. Recent research suggests that’s because there are a number of different biological mechanisms behind the disease.4 Other sex hormones like , ,5 and 6 seem to be altered in different forms of the condition, which can all result in different PCOS symptoms and outcomes for people. With so much complexity, diagnosing PCOS isn’t straightforward. Your doctor will usually start by first eliminating other possibilities for your symptoms.1 Ultrasound is also usually used to check for ovarian cysts (though their presence or absence doesn’t necessarily mean you do or don’t have PCOS). PCOS doesn’t always come with extreme or dangerous symptoms, but it can carry potentially harmful health impacts. In addition to diabetes, PCOS can lead to cardiovascular problems, high cholesterol levels, and increase your risk of endometrial cancer.1 What causes PCOS? Scientists don’t know what causes PCOS right now, though researchers are studying it. There’s likely a strong genetic component,7 meaning you inherit risk from your parents, though genetics is just one factor. Being overweight and having diabetes are also risk factors.1,8 What we do know is that people with PCOS often have too many hormones and are often resistant to . Scientists believe that resistance usually comes first and leads to excess s, though there are likely additional complexities.8 Insulin is a that regulates blood sugar. Your body typically produces it in response to increasing blood glucose levels, which lets your cells access energy. resistance happens when your body can no longer use like it should, which can lead to diabetes.9 resistance can also increase belly fat – a common experience for some people with PCOS. Scientists suspect that with PCOS, resistance likely disrupts certain sex hormones that help regulate your menstrual cycle, leading to issues like irregular periods and abnormal bleeding. This disruption prevents the release of eggs from your ovary and causes cysts to form, which produce s.8 Androgens interact with other sex hormones in your body and are involved in regulating the menstrual cycle , conception, and pregnancy.10 They’re also responsible for symptoms of PCOS like excess hair, acne , and skin problems.1 Treatments for PCOS There is no single treatment for PCOS, and treatments can vary depending on your symptoms and your overall health.11-12 Treatments for PCOS often include hormonal birth control, diabetes medications like metformin that treat resistance, high cholesterol drugs like statins, and blood pressure medications. In some cases, diet and exercise can also help.1 Is adyn right for you? Take the quiz. Can cure PCOS? Hormonal can help normalize levels, specifically by decreasing too-high levels which can cause many of the symptoms of PCOS .12-13 Many of the s used in decrease the production of s.12 So, doctors could prescribe a combined hormonal contraceptive like the combined pill or patch to help reduce your PCOS symptoms. One thing to note is that options can have different kinds of s , some of which are more androgenic than others. The best options for PCOS might include the s drospirenone, norethindrone, desogestrel, dienogest, and norgestimate, all of which are less androgenic than some other types of s.13 Can you get pregnant with PCOS? You can still get pregnant if you have PCOS, though it may be more difficult, and it can increase the risks to both the mother and the baby.1 One study of pregnancy and PCOS looked at over 3,700 pregnant people with the condition. Researchers found that 14% of mothers used assisted reproductive technology, versus just 1.5% of people without.14 That same study also found people with PCOS were more likely to experience pre-eclampsia – dangerously high blood pressure during a pregnancy – and gestational diabetes. They were also more likely to have very preterm births. That’s not to say you can’t have a healthy pregnancy if you do have PCOS. Don’t be afraid to talk to your doctor throughout your pregnancy so you can proactively monitor your health and get the best care possible. What to do if you think you have PCOS The symptoms of PCOS are broad, and they’re also not always present in everyone. Just because you have one or more symptoms of PCOS doesn’t mean you have the condition. But if you’re experiencing PCOS symptoms and you’ve been unable to figure out why, it might be worth asking your doctor if further testing is worth it, especially because the condition can occur alongside things like cardiovascular issues and diabetes. Doctors can request an ultrasound or additional tests that could help diagnose PCOS or rule it out. If you do have PCOS, it can be worth exploring whether an option like can alleviate your symptoms. title: Match Group & Uber Team Up with ‘It’s On Us’ to Empower College Students to Date Safely
summary: Match Group | Modern Dating & Matchmaking for Genuine Connections
body_text: Sep 16 2024 Match Group & Uber Team Up with ‘It’s On Us’ to Empower College Students to Date Safely Written by Unknown New Guide Offers Expert Safety Tips for Chatting with Matches, Meeting IRL, or Catching a Ride DALLAS , Sept. 16, 2024 /PRNewswire/ — Match Group, the parent company of Tinder and Hinge, is teaming up with Uber and It’s On Us , the largest US nonprofit program in the U.S. dedicated to college sexual assault prevention, to empower millions of students across 2,000+ colleges and universities nationwide with information on how to navigate the dating scene safely. Together, they’ve created a new guide in consultation with campus safety experts that highlights ways to date smarter and safer on- and off-campus. The guide also highlights ways to leverage app-specific tools like Verification and Reporting on Tinder and Hinge, and how to Check Your Ride before getting into an Uber. “College is a time for new experiences and connections, and dating apps often play a big role in that journey,” said Tasha Menaker , Senior Director of Social Impact at Match Group. “At Match Group, our priority is making sure that these connections are not only exciting but also safe for everyone involved. We’re proud to partner with Uber and It’s On Us to provide students with the knowledge they need to date confidently and securely.” The goal is to arm students with the knowledge and tools they need to stay safe and have the most positive dating experiences possible — whether they’re chatting with matches, meeting in person, or catching a ride. New and returning students can snag these guides from a local ‘It’s On Us’ chapter, through a campus ambassador, or online. Additional materials will be distributed throughout the school year. “At It’s On Us, our priority is to ensure that all students are able to pursue an education that is free from sexual violence,” said Tracey Vitchers , Executive Director of It’s On Us . “For many young students, college is the first time they will use dating apps or rideshare to connect with potential romantic partners. It’s critical that students are provided with the knowledge and resources that will help them safely and respectfully navigate their dating experiences from online, to in real life.” “At Uber, safety is at the core of everything that we do, which is why we’ve developed in-app safety features like Share My Trip, Safety Preferences and Pin Verification, to give riders additional peace of mind when they are on a trip,” said Emilie Boman , Director of Safety Public Policy at Uber. “Understanding that students have places to go, and people to meet, we’ve partnered with Match Group and It’s On Us, to provide them with essential tips and information, empowering them to feel secure wherever they travel.” This partnership is the latest in a series of initiatives aimed at reaching college students. In 2020, Tinder partnered with ‘It’s On Us’ to launch the first-ever national tour providing sexual assault prevention training for college students, by college students. Tinder also recently rolled out Share My Date , a feature that allows users to share their date plans—including location, date, time, and a photo of their match—directly with friends and loved ones from within the app up to 30 days in advance. Match Group, Uber, and ‘It’s On Us’ remain committed to helping campuses foster a culture of safety and respect in every interaction, both online and off. About Match Group Match Group (NASDAQ: MTCH), through its portfolio companies, is a leading provider of digital technologies designed to help people make meaningful connections. Our global portfolio of brands includes Tinder®, Hinge®, Match®, Meetic®, OkCupid®, Pairs™, PlentyOfFish®, Azar®, BLK®, and more, each built to increase our users’ likelihood of connecting with others. Through our trusted brands, we provide tailored services to meet the varying preferences of our users. Our services are available in over 40 languages to our users all over the world. About Uber Uber’s mission is to create opportunity through movement. We started in 2010 to solve a simple problem: how do you get access to a ride at the touch of a button? More than 42 billion trips later, we’re building products to get people closer to where they want to be. By changing how people, food, and things move through cities, Uber is a platform that opens up the world to new possibilities. About It’s On Us It’s On Us is building the movement to combat campus sexual assault by engaging all students, including young men, through grassroots organizing, prevention education programs, and large-scale culture change campaigns. Founded as an initiative of the Obama-Biden White House, It’s On Us has grown into the nation’s largest student organizing program dedicated to college sexual assault prevention, activating students on hundreds of campuses through awareness and education programs. It’s On Us is committed to shifting the culture around campus sexual assault through partnerships with media and brands that engage with millions of college students every day. It’s On Us is an initiative of Civic Nation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Learn more here . Safe Dating Tips From Dating Apps to Meeting In Person Be So For Real: Use real, recent photos. Be honest in your profile about what you’re looking for and who you are. No one wants to hang with a catfish unless it’s at a lake. On dating apps, users can get photo verified to help show other users that they are who they claim to be. Slide into DMs right: Got a match? Cool, but don’t be cringe. A cheesy line is fine to break the ice, but keep it chill and respectful. Show your personality. title: These 27 Food Freebies Will Help You Birthday Better
summary: Reap the benefits of savings with 27 free or highly discounted food items you can receive on your birthday.
body_text: It’s your special day, so put that wallet away. Many established eateries and dine-in restaurants celebrate with you by offering a delightful array of free or highly discounted food items. From complimentary appetizers and desserts to entire entrees, these tasty treats are a fantastic way to make your new year of you even more memorable. One thing to note: Many of these restaurants will require you to sign up for their rewards programs or email promotions to reap the benefits of free food. And while many of these promotions will be available the day you sign up, the vast majority will require you to activate your rewards account a week or two in advance. With a little pre-planning, you’ll be one step closer to enjoying your favorite birthday treats. Without further ado, here are 27 birthday freebies that cater to every taste and preference. Starting the Day Off Right: Breakfast Starbucks – Don’t talk to us until we’ve had our morning coffee. Good news: That morning coffee (or tea, alternative drink of choice, or favorite food item) is free on your birthday when you sign up for Starbucks’ Rewards Program . Limited to one item per order. Peet’s Coffee & Tea – They say variety is the spice of life. If you’re taking a break from the Starbucks line, the Peetnik Rewards Program will provide you with a free birthday beverage of your choosing. Denny’s – If a hearty breakfast is on your mind, Denny’s offers a Birthday Slam. You will just have to sign up for Denny’s Rewards Program . This offer is only available on your actual birthday, so make sure you bring a valid ID to your local Denny’s. IHOP – More of an IHOP fan? Just like Denny’s, you can stack up the savings with a free stack of pancakes on your birthday by signing up for their rewards program . If you would like to avoid signing up for their rewards program, you can attempt to call your local IHOP ahead of time to see if there are any local promotions. Waffle House – So, you’re more of a waffle person. We get it. Waffle House gets it, too. Enjoy a free waffle to start your year-older life right when you sign up for their Regulars Club . Krispy Kreme – Are donuts in the mix for your typical birthday festivities? You’re in luck. When you sign up for Krispy Kreme’s Rewards Program , you can enjoy three free donuts and other promotional food items at participating locations. Einstein Bros Bagels – It’s hard to resist a fresh bagel in the morning. It’s even harder to resist when it’s free. After signing up for Einstein Bros’ Schmear Society , you can savor the flavor of bagel and schmear with purchase just for signing up. On your birthday, Einstein Bros will even throw in a free egg sandwich with purchase. An All-Day Affair Panera Bread – Just for signing up for the MyPanera Rewards Program , you can enjoy a free pastry and free delivery for 30 days. Birthday rewards will automatically be loaded to your MyPanera account. Noodles & Company – Through their Noodles Rewards Program , you can start earning points to receive a free dessert or free entrée reward on your birthday. Jamba Juice – If you’ve spent at least $10 with a Jamba Rewards account, you can receive a free small smoothie on your birthday. You can also expect to get 50% off your first smoothie after signing up for your account. After that, you’ll receive another offer for 50% off a food item. Smoothie King – You can also slurp down Smoothie King’s finest when signed up for their Healthy Rewards Program . Sweetgreen – If this year is all about healthy eating, start your birthday on the right note with a fresh salad. Through the Sweetpass program , you can receive a Birthday Gift Reward in the form of a discount for up to $10 in value. Cracker Barrel – Craving some classic homestyle cooking? Come to Cracker Barrel on your birthday and you’ll get a free dessert and song. Sounds like a win-win to us. Olive Garden – When you dine in, Olive Garden will provide a complimentary dessert on your birthday. There’s no requirement to sign up for their eClub , but you can enjoy their array of discount offers if you’re interested. Bucca di Beppo – Maybe you’re still craving Italian on your birthday. When you sign up for their eClub , you will receive a $20 birthday credit every year and a few other tempting offers. Applebee’s – When you join Club Applebee’s , you will immediately receive a free appetizer offer. On your birthday, Applebee’s also offers a free birthday treat. Chili’s Bar & Grill – Did somebody say free dessert? Chili’s did. And when you create a My Chili’s Rewards account, you can save even more on restaurant favorites. Outback Steakhouse – This one is simple! Just tell your server it’s your birthday and a free dessert will come out faster than you can say ‘barbecue’. Subway – If it’s been some time since you stopped by for a sub, Subway provides birthday and member anniversary freebies through their rewards program . Which Wich? – Go grab a free regular 7” Wich when you sign up for the Vibe Club rewards program. Chipotle – How many times have you been told the guacamole would cost extra? Through Chipotle’s Rewards Program , you can enjoy free guacamole and chips on your special day. However, most locations will require you to purchase something that’s at least $5 to receive this offer. Some More Sweet Treats Baskin Robbins – Ditch the traditional cake for a scoop of your favorite icy dessert. When you opt in to Baskin Robbin’s Birthday Club , you’ll receive a 2.5oz scoop of your favorite ice cream. Cold Stone Creamery – Every year on your birthday, you’ll receive a buy-one-get-one free offer on all Cold Stone Creations through their My Cold Stone Club Rewards program . That seems pretty chill to us. TCBY – Maybe you want to indulge with a slightly less calorie-heavy treat. When you join the Froyo Club and add a birthday month to your personal profile, you can receive a free frozen yogurt on your birthday. Edible Arrangements – Feel like the ultimate sweets VIP with a free 6-count chocolate-dipped fruit box when you sign up for the Edible Awards program . Nothing Bundt Cake – It’s hard to pass up any kind of cake on your birthday. If you’re looking to swap out store-bought birthday cake for something different, Nothing Bundt Cake’s eClub offers a free bundtlet. Crumbl – These delectable confections are taking the internet by storm. If you’d like to see (and taste) what all the hype is about, simply download the Crumbl Cookies app, join Crumbl loyalty , and enter your birth date. When your birthday rolls around, you’ll receive a voucher for a free cookie in the Crumbl app. However you decide to celebrate this year, we hope you have good times, birthday treats, and some great eats along the way.
